prompt:
Our payments team had a production incident last weekend and we need a full operational audit before the next release. We have two things that need processing:

1. There's a raw distributed trace log file at `data/raw/2024-06/incident_traces.jsonl` — it contains the spans captured during the incident window. We need this ingested into a queryable database so the SRE team can run post-mortem queries.

2. We also have our release pipeline configuration at `ci/configs/release_pipeline.json`. Before we deploy the next hotfix, our compliance officer needs confirmation that it meets our PCI-DSS security and testing standards. Please run a validation check and save the findings.

Once both steps are done, please produce a combined `audit_summary.json` file that captures the key numbers from the trace ingestion (how many spans were loaded, how many were rejected) alongside the pipeline compliance findings (what violations were found and their severity). The SRE lead and compliance officer will review this together in tomorrow's post-mortem meeting.
